newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thais offer Mitsubishi tax package for tube plant.
newsitem.headline: Thais offer Mitsubishi tax package for tube plant.

text.p: Thailand's Board of Investment (BoI) on Monday approved a tax incentive package for Mitsubishi Materials Corp to open a 30,000-tonne copper tube plant in south eastern Rayong province.

A BoI statement said Mitsubishi Materials' MMC Copper Tube (Thailand) Ltd unit would invest 3.15 billion baht ($125 million) in the plant and machinery and spend another 2.73 billion baht on land and as operating capital for its wholly owned project.

The BoI did not detail the tax package offered to Mitsubishi. But it added that the plant would export at least 30 percent of its tubes, which are used mainly for air-conditioners and potentially earn Thailand about 1.40 billion baht in foreign exchange a year.
The plant is scheduled to start production in 1998.
